section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a study, including obtaining permission to use the BAS-2, ethics approval, and the translation and back-translation process of the BAS-2 into Persian. Data collection occurred between December 2014 and June 2015 in seven large universities in Tehran, Iran, where university students completed a paper-and-pencil survey, which included the BAS-2, anonymously in classroom settings.
